openings.claim: Current assignments may misselect historical courses; renames may affect selection or recognition. Authorized stable-identity course-week manifests might prevent reconciliation.
openings.discriminator: Vary assignments/names independently; compare membership and recognition. Fixed manifests resist changes; incomplete manifests fail.
openings.probe: Compare incumbent/manifest using fabricated unchanged/reassigned/renamed/split cases. Coordinators predeclare scope, including empty courses; inspect identities/CSV labels, omissions, correction authority and foreign-center sentinels. Count upkeep plus handling.
openings.uncertainty: Causality, historical data, stable identities, trustworthy scope and implementation cost unverified.

openings.claim: Reconciliation, import and replacement fulfillment may contribute differently.
openings.probe: Six coordinators, two short sessions each, diverse timetable styles: time checking/correction/download/import and request-to-start/completion-to-access.
openings.uncertainty: Timetable completeness and session realism unknown.

openings.claim: Authenticated self-service replacements may remove intermediary waiting.
openings.discriminator: Waiting shrinks; active effort/accuracy may persist.
openings.probe: Compare paths; validate center/week/course scope, forged/repeated requests, failures and latest completed-file retrieval.
openings.uncertainty: Mediation versus necessary correction; exposure feasibility unverified.

decision: Probe before choosing. Preserve private authorized delivery, documented CSV/import and concurrent attendance within six engineer-days/existing hosting; verify mechanism feasibility. Reject leakage; sampled absence excludes split center. Synthetic sessions cannot establish next-40 targets: median handling <=12 minutes, >=95% intended course sets, zero foreign-center records.
